parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.
If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, check the value of the CasterId parameter returned in the response.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page to view the ID.

The name of the production studio in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page in the ApsaraVideo Live console is the ID of the production studio
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the layout. If you added the layout by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848025.html operation, check the value of the LayoutId parameter returned in the response
parameters.help_zh: 布局ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848025.html添加导播台布局，请查看AddCasterLayout接口调用返回的参数LayoutId值
parameters.name: layout_id

CasterId.description_en: The ID of the production studio. You can use this ID as a request parameter to modify a production studio layout, query the list of production studio layouts, add a production studio component, or query the list of production studio components
CasterId.description_zh: 导播台ID。可作为修改导播台布局、查询导播台布局列表、添加导播台组件、查询导播台组件列表的请求参数

LayoutId.description_en: The ID of the layout. You can use this ID as a request parameter to query the list of production studio layouts
LayoutId.description_zh: 布局ID。可作为查询导播台布局列表的请求参数
